verdict.rationale: Portkey's first-party docs describe gateway-level response caching that serves requests "up to 20x faster and cheaper". It offers both simple caching and semantic caching, which matches similar prompts by cosine similarity, and the cost-management page cites intelligent caching as a way to cut spend. missing for 10: configuration details (TTL, cache invalidation, force-refresh), independent or hands-on corroboration of the cost and latency gains.

support.subject: As a developer, I can cache responses at the gateway to cut cost and latency on repeated requests

citations.quote: Cache LLM responses to serve requests up to **20x faster** and cheaper.
Matches requests with **similar meaning** using cosine similarity, not just identical text.
Set up granular cost tracking, intelligent caching, and smart routing to cut infrastructure spends without touching your application logic.
